format: Boxes are [x, y, width, height], normalized 0..1 on the analysis frame. index = harness sample index at sampleFps (identical to ffmpeg fps=12 frame n). movers: something genuinely moving in the world. ignore: ambiguous (stopped vehicles, standing/sitting people, too small to judge) - blobs there count neither way. roi: only blobs whose center is inside it are scored (omitted = whole frame). Every other blob in the roi is a false positive. Drafted by Claude from frame pairs 0.5 s apart (motion judged against the background); review with `npm run overlay`.
notes: Forward flight over a park, then low over houses. Basketball courts with active players are one mover box per court. Frame 348 has no movers at all: every blob there is a false positive. roi excludes the horizon band.
